name: stress-ng funccall
description: Start N workers that call functions of 1 through to 9 arguments. By default all functions with a range of argument types are called, however, this can be changed using the --funccall-method option. This exercises stack function argument passing and re-ordering on the stack and in registers. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
